## Which surface?

- [ ] CLI (`veylqorix`)
- [ ] MCP server
- [ ] API / dashboard
- [ ] GitHub Actions gate
- [ ] Git hooks
- [ ] Rust engine (`crates/veylqorix-engine`)
- [ ] Plugin SDK (`packages/plugin`)
- [ ] Other:

## What did you try?

The command(s) or configuration you used, the version / commit, and the
result (exit code, and whether the gate ran on the Rust engine or the
TypeScript fallback — see `docs/engine.md`).

## What are you trying to do?

The outcome you want.

Before opening, check `docs/troubleshooting.md` and `docs/faq.md` — many
questions ("secret not detected", "gate not blocking", "scanner reports
SKIPPED / ERROR") are answered there. If your question is really a bug, a
feature request, or a docs error, use the matching template instead.
